description: This file implements the DefaultPreemption plugin for Kubernetes scheduler, handling preemption logic including victim selection, filtering, and event registration.

classes.name: DefaultPreemption
classes.description: A Kubernetes scheduler plugin implementing preemption logic, victim selection, and event handling.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the plugin.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new DefaultPreemption plugin instance.

methods.name: PostFilter
methods.description: Invoked after filtering nodes to perform preemption evaluation.

methods.name: PreEnqueue
methods.description: Handles pre-enqueue logic for pods, especially for async preemption.

methods.name: EventsToRegister
methods.description: Returns events that can trigger re-evaluation of pods for preemption.

methods.name: isPodSchedulableAfterPodDeletion
methods.description: Determines queueing hints after pod deletion events.

methods.name: calculateNumCandidates
methods.description: Calculates number of candidate nodes for preemption based on constraints.

methods.name: GetOffsetAndNumCandidates
methods.description: Selects a random offset and number of candidates for dry run preemption.

methods.name: CandidatesToVictimsMap
methods.description: Maps candidates to their victims for preemption.

methods.name: SelectVictimsOnNode
methods.description: Finds minimum set of pods to preempt on a node to schedule a given pod.

methods.name: PodEligibleToPreemptOthers
methods.description: Checks if a pod is eligible to preempt others.

methods.name: isPreemptionAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a victim pod can be preempted by a preemptor pod.

methods.name: podTerminatingByPreemption
methods.description: Checks if a pod is terminating due to preemption.

methods.name: filterPodsWithPDBViolation
methods.description: Groups pods into violating and non-violating based on PodDisruptionBudgets.
